quote: Surpass your limits right here, right now, and prove everyone wrong who ever doubted your path.

Power does not come from desire alone; it comes in direct response to an absolute, unyielding need.
Human beings are strong because we possess the extraordinary capability to change and rebuild ourselves.
If you do nothing when facing a wall, you will remain trapped in the exact same place forever.
When you hit your limit, remember why you started and let that purpose push you beyond your boundaries.
Pain is the ultimate teacher. You cannot gain true strength without sacrificing comfort and security.
The difference between a novice and a master is that the master has failed more times than the beginner has tried.
My magic is never giving up, no matter how steep the mountain or how dark the night becomes.
